Name: Quaint Living - Lily Garden
Author: PlatinumCats
Description:
This mod adds 5 lilies from Quaint Living - Flower Garden to the game sold by Pierre. 

Please do not install this mod if you already have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15107/]Quaint Living - Flower Garden.
[/url]

[img=center]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/15161/15161-1674388497-1723280753.png[/img]


Happy gardening!
[line][b]
List of flowers added:[/b][line]
Summer:
[spoiler]
* Golden Splendor Lily
* Regal Lily (Year 2)
* Tiger Lily (Year 2)
* Tiny Bee Lily
* Stargazer Lily
[/spoiler]
[b]
[line]
Notes:[/b][line]
* This mod is intended for those who don't wish to install Quaint Living - Flower Garden but want the lilies.
* Some of the lilies are intentionally made to be only available in year 2. If you want to unlock them earlier, feel free to edit the crop.json inside each of the lilies folders for your personal use.
* The name of most of the flowers included in this mod are true to their real-life counterpart, while the remaining few are modified for compatibility with other mods, or simply to make the names fit with the Stardew Valley vibe in general.
